run_train_autoencoder_rae: run the AutoencoderRAE training script with an ImageFolder dataset and save checkpoints to output_dir
build_transforms_image_dataset: build torchvision transforms that resize, crop, optionally flip, and convert images to tensors for training
compute_losses_reconstruction: compute L1 or MSE reconstruction loss and optional encoder feature consistency loss for AutoencoderRAE training
load_pretrained_encoder_weights: load pretrained DINOv2, SigLIP2, or MAE encoder weights into an AutoencoderRAE model with stripped layernorm affine params
review_main_training_loop: review the main training loop that uses Accelerate for distributed training with gradient accumulation, checkpointing, and logging
